# Backlog Syntax

> Open-source task management for people and AI agents, with REST, OpenAPI, MCP and PostgreSQL tenant isolation.

## Main pages
- /en (English) and / (Brazilian Portuguese): product status and architecture
- /en/docs and /documentacao: REST, remote MCP, WebMCP, authorization and concurrency
- /en/transparency and /transparencia: product and data-processing status
- /en/privacy and /privacidade: privacy notice, providers and data-subject rights
- /en/terms and /termos: hosted-service terms
- /en/cookies and /cookies: necessary cookies and current behavior

Public pages also support `Accept: text/markdown` on the same URL. Private workspaces,
authentication screens and API responses are excluded from this representation.
Public content preferences: search=yes, ai-input=yes, ai-train=no.

This optional discovery aid does not replace the website, README or public documentation.
It is not a search-engine indexing requirement or a guarantee of AI citations.
